notes.title: Fogtown TV pilot episode, Mystery of the Moth Napper, is out!
notes.notes:
While you wait for [i]A Rum Case in Fogtown[/i] to come out, we hit a huge milestone for Fogtown as a whole this week — the TV pilot we've been developing in tandem with the game for the past four years, [i]Mystery of the Moth Napper[/i], has released!

[previewyoutube=uRnwGom6zag;full][/previewyoutube]

Starring Stephen Russell (Garrett from Thief! Nick Valentine in Fallout 4!) as the titular mothnapping menace, [i]Mystery of the Moth Napper[/i] has Sherblock struggling for recognition while trying to crack a bewildering, lifelong case.

It's an original story that won't be retold in the game, which concerns a totally different mystery (and is set before the events of the pilot, when Sherblock and Blockson have only recently begun working together).

We hope you enjoy this taste of what Fogtown's all about. Next up for us: expanding our small demo for [b]A Rum Case in Fogtown[/b] into something a bit more substantial before it releases to the web as soon as we can in 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/13633da6f3acd81f048ca59ca7d044c397436ce7.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled at what our viewers are telling us about the pilot. [b]Here's some of what they've had to say![/b]

notes.title: A RUM CASE IN FOGTOWN unveiled!
notes.notes:
After years of toiling behind the scenes on both the Fogtown TV series and the game, we’re finally able to reveal some screenshots and talk about our new title: [i]A Rum Case in Fogtown[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/1ee341a95e73805beb32faea3833249fcfa2f1a0.png[/img]

We also have a demo that’s just a few days away from debuting at the Adventure Game Fan Fair this weekend, which will (eventually — SOON!) make its way online for all to try, once we’ve ensured it plays nicely across a wide range of systems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/b57ed48bd46222359f10374148db832d73250a43.jpg[/img]
[i]A Rum Case in Fogtown[/i] is a mystery/comedy prequel to the Fogtown TV series, taking place in the early days of Sherblock & Blockson’s partnership. When a mysterious saboteur strikes their favorite pub (upending the livelihood of its beloved proprietor), our lads leap into action to find the culprit… or perhaps they do a terrible job and end the game in hilariously premature fashion — your choice, players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/efd0c54543a19aa5cd703a37261cdd9f487e9be0.jpg[/img]
Gameplay is entirely FMV-based, with frequent choices that shape your experience: some with far-reaching consequences, and some just with fun bits of flavor that personalize your playthrough. Due to all the branching possibilities, we like to think of it as a highly replayable experience, but for those who just like to complete games once, we’re confident the story will be satisfying either way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/d50f5c6cb2fbaf03e8556843e6c32406d20c3026.jpg[/img]
We’ll have more to share in the coming weeks, but in the meantime we just wanted to spruce up this Steam page, reveal the game title, and thank you for your interest in this delightfully fun little passion project of ours. So… thank you! And talk soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/3e5b5a03364b05dd0b878ff11d2e4a5ecfc7384c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay World Premiere at the Adventure Game Fan Fair!
notes.notes:
Some of you have been waiting long for tangible news on [i]Fogtown[/i]. We’re pleased to announce that in the very near future, you’ll be able to get your hands on it yourself for a test spin!

We’re thrilled to share that [i]Fogtown[/i] is coming to the [b]Adventure Game Fan Fair[/b], a brand-new three day convention held in the Pacific Northwest at Tacoma's University of Washington, running July 26th-28th.

[url=https://adventuregamefanfair.com/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/c1f411d6c8bbbee4acd7cd9a2d1f3f8382a1ac19.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/de8f6d511aaaf9cb248555dfaf43cf10efe75890.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/015262f297b90f49ecab2e998e279cbf7a5c694e.jpg[/img]
[/url]

This expo is shaping up to be a total delight for adventure game developers and fans alike. Attendees will be able to meet legendary game designers Jane Jensen and Roberta Williams (plus many more heroes from the golden years of [b]Sierra[/b] and [b]LucasArts[/b]) in addition to getting their hands on exclusive builds of unreleased adventure games demoing for the very first time. That includes [i]Fogtown[/i]!

If you want to attend the Fan Fair and try out Fogtown in person, tickets are limited! They can be purchased at: [url=https://adventuregamefanfair.com/]https://adventuregamefanfair.com/[/url]

For those unable to attend, don’t despair! We plan to release the Fogtown demo to the general public at a TBD date later this year.
[hr][/hr]Our team is hard at work prepping the demo for our madcap, choice-based FMV game like no other, and can’t wait to see how its received. While we aren’t ready to showcase the game in action just yet, we can share some recently-finished environments, sure to house mesmerizing mysteries (and potential perils).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/93e93109e4ab3959a9b4fecf42b371f2a5422028.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/a7aa45fba23423e76ba77403eacd8eb0bf10f079.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/baaee8429fbcda07d5ef76ac99f227342770075e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/bef5e6a69dc834dca16a18c72cace31fc5cb6f75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42694916/180cabaeb96bda83dbde7f8e02d651a98f870010.png[/img]
[i](Don’t be scared, that’s not a spooky spectre in the second shot, it’s simply a Sherblock stand-in to support the sculpting of the scene at a suitable scale!)[/i]

We hope to see many of you at the Fan Fair. Til next time, stay foggy!

notes.title: Fogtown Unveiled at Rose City Comic Con
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that on September 22, we'll be part of Rose City Comic Con in Portland, OR. You can join us at the Weird Stage at 2pm to see a world premiere of scenes from our in-production Fogtown TV pilot, meet the creators and developers of the Fogtown game, learn more about the creative process behind how Fogtown gets made, and bother us for juicy unannounced details to your heart's content!

[url=https://rosecitycomiccon.com/programming/#/event/fogtown-unveiled-a-puppet-based-mystery-comedy][img]https://i.imgur.com/NcnRRhh.jpg[/img][/url]

You can get passes for the convention at the [url=https://rosecitycomiccon.com/]RCCC website[/url].

We hope to see a number of you there, and more announcements about the game will be coming soon. (Hint hint, mark your calendars for the first-ever [url=https://adventuregamehotspot.com/aghcon2024/]Adventure Game Hotspot Convention[/url] in 2024...)

Lastly, if you've been craving another dose of Sherblockian shenanigans ever since our 2022 crowdfunder wrapped up, we released a pair of Fogtown shorts!

First up is a thank-you to all the lovely adventure game developers who helped spread the word about Fogtown during our 2022 crowdfunding campaign.

[previewyoutube=hV1E_IOTG18;full][/previewyoutube]
Second is an.... "educational" FAQ series to answer your burning questions, but don't expect to glean much straightforward information from it.

[previewyoutube=L7Vr4Dfsno0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for following along, and stay foggy, friends!
